P.name: Cosmic Creator
P.title: Template:Data Aurelion Sol/Cosmic Creator
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Cosmic Creator|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Aurelion Sol
|skill        = I
|icon         = Cosmic Creator.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Aurelion Sol's''' damaging [[champion ability|abilities]] against enemies generate him permanent stacks of {{as|Stardust}}, which gradually augments his abilities.
* ''{{ai|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'': Bursts deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
* ''{{ai|Astral Flight|Aurelion Sol}}'': Range is increased by {{as|{{fd|7.5}} units per Stardust}}.
* ''{{ai|Singularity|Aurelion Sol}}'': Outer and inner radius increased equal to {{as|15% Stardust}}, and the execution threshold is increased.
* ''{{ai|Falling Star|Aurelion Sol}} / {{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'': Impact radius increased equal to {{as|15% Stardust}}.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|notes        = 
* {{ais|Singularity|Aurelion Sol}} relative size and ratio stays the same when affected by ''Cosmic Creator's'' size modifier.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurbicon    = Cosmic Creator.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Aurelion Sol}} damaging abilities against enemies generate him permanent stacks of {{as|Stardust}}, which gradually augments his abilities.
* ''{{ais|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'' bursts deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
* ''{{ais|Astral Flight|Aurelion Sol}}'' distance is increased.
* ''{{ais|Singularity|Aurelion Sol}}'' area and execute threshold are increased.
* ''{{ai|Falling Star|Aurelion Sol}}''/''{{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'' has increased impact area.
}}

Q.name: Breath of Light
Q.title: Template:Data Aurelion Sol/Breath of Light

flags.costtype: Mana {{tt|(+ {{ap|30*0.25 to 50*0.25}} Mana per {{fd|0.25}} seconds)|Cost for mana per 0.25 seconds starts being paid after 1.25 seconds into the channel.}}

Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Breath of Light|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Aurelion Sol
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Breath of Light.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' {{tip|channel|charges}} for up to {{fd|3.25}} seconds to exhale a beam of starfire, during which he can steer the beam in the target direction. The beam collides with the first enemy hit to burn them, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to them and surrounding enemies every {{fd|0.125}} seconds. Secondary targets are dealt 50% damage.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|45/8 to 105/8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55/8}}% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|45 to 105}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}|{{tt|Total Maximum Magic Damage|Ranks 1-4}}|{{ap|(45/8)*26 to ((45+(105-45)*(3/4))/8)*26 4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(55/8)*26}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Secondary Target Damage per Tick|{{ap|(45/8)*0.5 to (105/8)*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(55/8)*0.5}}% AP)}}|Secondary Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|45*0.5 to 105*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*0.5}}% AP)}}|{{tt|Secondary Target Total Maximum Damage|Ranks 1-4}}|{{ap|(45/8)*26*0.5 to ((45+(105-45)*(3/4))/8)*26*0.5 4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(55/8)*26*0.5}}% AP)}}}}
|description2 = Against the primary target, the beam will deal a burst of {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} for each full second that it burns them, and additionally generates {{as|2 Stardust}} if they are a {{tip|champion}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against {{tip|monsters}}.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 100}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{ai|Cosmic Creator|Aurelion Sol|{{as|(+|hp}} {{as|({{fd|3.1}}% Stardust)}}{{as|%|hp}} {{as|of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|hp}}}}
|description3 = ''Breath of Light'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
|description4 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' ends ''Breath of Light'' early.
|description5 = At rank 5, ''Breath of Light's'' channel duration is increased to 160 seconds.
|description6 = ''If the channel is cancelled within the first {{fd|0.25}} seconds, Breath of Light is placed on a 1-second {{tip|lockout}} but does not go on cooldown.''
|cooldown     = 3
|cdstart      = post-effect
|customlabel  = Turn rate
|custominfo   = 180{{degree}}/s
|cost         = {{ap|30 to 50}}
|costtype     = Mana {{tt|(+ {{ap|30*0.25 to 50*0.25}} Mana per {{fd|0.25}} seconds)|Cost for mana per 0.25 seconds starts being paid after 1.25 seconds into the channel.}}
|range        = {{pp|750 to 920}}
|effect radius= <!--{{tt|X|Secondary target damaging radius around primary target}}-->
|width        = 
|angle        = 
|cast time    = none
|queue time   = {{fd|0.25}}
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = special
|spelleffects = special
|projectile   = false
|silence      = true
|callforhelp  = special
|notes        = 
{{always quickcast}}
* Applies {{tip|persistent damage}} on the burst and {{tip|persistent area damage}} on the beam.
* ''Breath of Light's'' total mana cost after channeling it for its maximum duration is {{ap|30*3|35*3|40*3|45*3|50*158+50*0.75}}.
* ''Breath of Light's'' bursts against an enemy champion will aggro nearby enemy minions.
* ''Breath of Light's'' burn places a timer on the primary target, which ticks in {{fd|0.2}} second intervals. Thus, at{{ft|5 completed intervals,|1 full second,}}the burst damage is triggered.
** The timer's visuals themselves otherwise serve no other purpose than gameplay clarity.
** The timer is placed on the initial primary target and any new primary targets that are acquired during the channel.
*** It falls off and resets to zero if a target is not hit within 1 second of no longer being afflicted by the burn.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the burst damage.
* The following table refers to interactions while '''Aurelion Sol''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
{{ct|channel|attack=interrupts|cast=interrupts|move=interrupts|items=interrupts,true,,false|spells=true,interrupts,false,interrupts,interrupts}}
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurbicon    = Breath of Light.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Aurelion Sol}} {{tip|channel|charges}} up to a short time, exhaling a beam in the target direction that continuously deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and reduced damage to other enemies. {{ci|Aurelion Sol}} can steer the beam in any direction.
|blurb2       = The beam will deal a burst of {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} for each full second that it damages the same enemy, and generates {{as|Stardust}} if the target is a {{tip|champion}}.
|blurb4       = At max rank, ''Breath of Light's'' channel duration may last indefinitely.
}}

W.name: Astral Flight
W.title: Template:Data Aurelion Sol/Astral Flight
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Astral Flight|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Aurelion Sol
|skill        = W
|icon         = Astral Flight.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction and resets ''{{ais|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}. During flight, he has {{tip|unobstructed vision}} and ''{{ai|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'' has no cooldown and maximum channel duration and its non-burst flat damage is increased, but ''Astral Flight's'' dash speed is reduced by 50% during its channel.
|leveling     = {{st|{{ai|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}} Flat Damage Modifier|{{ap|108 to 112}}%}}
|description2 = '''''Aurelion Sol''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} crowd control during the dash.''
|description3 = ''Astral Flight'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the dash, and does so automatically upon arrival.
|icon4        = Astral Flight 2.png
|description4 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' ends ''Astral Flight''.
|description5 = Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them reduces ''Astral Flight's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 90% of its '''total''' cooldown.
|description6 = '''''Aurelion Sol''' will not dash after the cast time if he was {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}} during it. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash. {{ais|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}} channel will be interrupted if Astral Flight ends or {{ai|Singularity|Aurelion Sol}} or {{ai|Falling Star|Aurelion Sol}} / {{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}} is cast during the flight, but the ability will automatically be cast afterwards.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|22 to 14}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = {{ap|50 to 70}}
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = 1500 (+ {{fd|7.5}}{{times}}{{as|Stardust}})
|speed        = {{dv|{{tt|{{ccd|Aurelion Sol|ms}} + {{as|100% movement speed}}|Dash speed}}|{{tt|{{ap|{{ccd|Aurelion Sol|ms}}*0.5}} + {{as|{{ap|100*0.5}}% movement speed}}|Dash speed while channeling Breath of Light}}}}
|cast time    = {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.4}}|Initial cast  (0.375, rounded to the next game tick)}}|{{tt|None|Recast}}}}
|queue time   = {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.35}}|Initial cast}}|{{tt|{{fd|0.35}}|Recast}}}}
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Self
|grounded     = true
|knockdown    = true
|notes        = 
* If a {{tip|takedown}} is scored while ''Astral Flight'' is active, the cooldown will be reduced after it ends.
* ''Astral Flight'' cannot be used in the first 15 seconds of the game.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Aurelion Sol''' is {{tip|dash|dashing}}:
{{ct|attack=interrupts|move=interrupts|cast=true|items=true,,interrupts,interrupts|consume=true|spells=true,interrupts,false,false,true|interrupts=death,root}}
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurbicon    = Astral Flight.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Aurelion Sol}} {{tip|dash|flies}} in the target direction. During flight, he can cast any of his abilities, and ''{{ai|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'' has no {{sti|cooldown}}, no maximum channel duration, and its flat damage is increased. {{ci|Aurelion Sol}} flies at a reduced speed while channeling ''{{ai|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}''.
|blurb2       = ''Astral Flight'' can be recast during flight, and does so automatically upon arrival.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Recast:}} {{ci|Aurelion Sol}} ends ''Astral Flight''.
|blurb4       = Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them refunds a large portion of ''Astral Flight's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
}}

E.name: Singularity
E.title: Template:Data Aurelion Sol/Singularity
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Singularity|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Aurelion Sol
|skill        = E
|icon         = Singularity.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' conjures a black hole at the target location after a {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}-second delay|From start of cast time}} that lasts for 5 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area and dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies within.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|2.5 to 7.5}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|2.5*20 to 7.5*20}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3*20}}% AP)}}}}
|description2 = Enemies in the black hole are {{tip|kinematics|dragged}} inward until they reach the center, and {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} also have their {{as|movement speed}} '''reduced''' to a {{as|static 0|ms}}. Enemies within the center are {{tip|execute|executed}} below {{as|5%|hp}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.6}}% per 100 Stardust)}} {{as|of their '''maximum''' health}}, excluding epic monsters. 
|description3 = After ''Singularity'' ends, it generates {{as|1 Stardust}} for each full second that enemy champions were inside it, as well as varying amounts for enemy units that were killed while being within the area:
* Champions and epic monsters grant {{as|2 Stardust}}.
* Large minions and monsters grant {{as|2 Stardust}}.
* Small minions and monsters grant {{as|1 Stardust}}.
|cooldown     = 12
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = 90
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = {{pplevel|750 to 920}}
|effect radius= {{tip|er|icononly=true}} √({{tt|275|Radius at 0 Stardust}}² + {{fd|16.93}}² {{times}} {{as|Stardust}})
|inner radius = {{tip|er|icononly=true}} √({{tt|{{fd|137.5}}|Radius at 0 Stardust}}² + {{fd|8.46}}² {{times}} {{as|Stardust}})
|cast time    = {{fd|0.2}}
|queue time   = {{fd|0.35}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = special
|spelleffects = aoedot
|callforhelp  = special
|outofrange   = Target at maximum range (clamped) if cast within 200 units beyond it or during ''{{ai|Astral Flight|Aurelion Sol}}''. Otherwise, walk in range of the target location to cast.
|notes        = 
* {{tip|Clones}} are counted as champions for all of this ability's effects and grant stacks of {{as|Stardust}} if they are killed in the area.
* The damage area hits targets by their {{tip|edge range|edge}}, while the {{tip|kinematics}} area hits targets by their {{tip|centered range|center}}. This makes a slight fringe where targets may be damaged without displacing them.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block a single instance of damage.
* ''Singularity's'' execute against an enemy champion will aggro nearby enemy minions.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurbicon    = Singularity.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Aurelion Sol}} conjures a black hole at the target location for a few seconds that continually deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within. Enemies in the black hole are {{tip|kinematics|dragged}} toward the center. Enemies within the center are {{tip|execute|executed}} {{as|at low health}}.
|blurb2       = After ''Singularity'' ends, it generates {{as|Stardust}} for each full second that enemy champions were inside, as well as for each enemy {{tip|takedown}}.
}}

R.name: Falling Star
R.title: Template:Data Aurelion Sol/Falling Star
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Falling Star|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Aurelion Sol
|skill        = R
|icon         = Falling Star.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' calls down a star that strikes the target location after {{fd|1.25}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second. This generates {{as|5 Stardust}} for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}}}
|description2 = Once ''Falling Star'' has been learned, gathering {{as|75 Stardust}} causes the next cast of ''Falling Star'' to transform into ''{{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'', empowering the impact with new effects.
|cooldown     = {{ap|120 to 100}}
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = 1250
|effect radius= {{tip|er|icononly=true}} √({{tt|275|Radius at 0 Stardust}}² + {{fd|16.93}}² {{times}} {{as|Stardust}})
|cast time    = none
|queue time   = {{fd|0.35}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = true
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|projectile   = false
|callforhelp  = true
|outofrange   = Target at maximum range (clamped) if cast within 200 units beyond it or during ''{{ai|Astral Flight|Aurelion Sol}}''. Otherwise, walk in range of the target location to cast.
|notes        = 
* '''Aurelion Sol''' will transform ''Falling Star'' into ''{{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'' each time he gathers {{as|75 Stardust}} from the last time he used the empowered cast, or once he has gathered that amount after learning the ability.
* {{as|Stardust}} required for transformation is denoted by a progress bar over ''Falling Star'' in the HUD.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurbicon    = Falling Star.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Aurelion Sol}} calls down a star that strikes the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} enemies hit. This generates {{as|Stardust}} for each enemy champion hit.
|blurb2       = After gathering enough {{as|Stardust}}, the next cast of ''Falling Star'' transforms into ''{{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'', empowering the impact with new effects.
|post-blurb = Aurelion Sol/The Skies Descend
|flavorsound = {{sm2|Aurelion_Sol_Original_SFX_R_Announcement_ready_buffactivate_self.ogg}} {{tt|''Transformation alert.''|This sound effect plays when Falling Star has been upgraded to The Skies Descend.}}
}}
